requirements.text: The system must allow users to toggle between light and dark themes using a dark mode switch. Specifically, when the user interacts with the dark mode switch located by the data-testid 'dark-mode-switch', the system should apply the 'dark-mode' class to the body element when the switch is in the 'checked' position, thereby enabling dark mode. Conversely, when the switch is in the 'unchecked' position, the 'dark-mode' class should be removed from the body element, reverting to light mode.
The Loan Calculator web application must handle user valid numeric input in the 'Loan Amount' input field with data-testid 'amount-input'.
When the user enters a value in the 'Interest Rate' input field with data-testid 'rate-input', the system should accept and store the numeric value for calculation purposes.

When the user interacts with the 'Loan Term' input field, the system should handle and store the numeric value for calculation purposes, covering various scenarios including normal, edge, and error cases.

The Loan Calculator web application must ensure that when a user adjusts the 'Loan Term' slider, the 'Loan Term' input field is dynamically updated to reflect the slider's current value. Specifically, the slider element, identified by data-testid 'year-slider', should allow users to select a value between 1 and 30, inclusive. Upon adjustment, the input field with data-testid 'years-input' must immediately display the selected slider value.

The system must calculate and display the monthly payment, total payment, and total interest when the user clicks the 'Calculate' button (data-testid 'calculate-button'). The monthly payment is calculated using the formula M = P * (r * (1 + r)^n) / ((1 + r)^n - 1), with special handling for 0 interest rate (M = P / n). Total payment is M * n, and total interest is Total Payment - Principal. The results are displayed in the format 'Monthly Payment: $[value]', 'Total Payment: $[value]', and 'Total Interest: $[value]' (data-testids 'monthly-payment', 'total-payment', 'total-interest'). If any input is invalid or missing, the system must alert the user with the message "Please check your numbers" and prevent the calculation.
When the user clicks the 'Calculate' button and the input values are valid, the doughnut chart (data-testid 'payment-chart') will update to show the proportions of principal and interest.

When the 'Calculate' button is clicked, the system should check the validity of the input values. If any of the values are zero or invalid, an alert should be displayed with the message 'Please check your numbers'.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User enables dark mode
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Dark Mode Toggle
  The system should apply or remove the "dark-mode" class to the body element when the user toggles the dark mode switch, changing the application"s theme.


  Scenario: [Normal] User enables dark mode
    Given the Loan Calculator page is loaded
    When the user toggles the dark mode switch with data-testid "dark-mode-slider" to the "checked" position
    Then the body element should have the class "dark-mode"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User disables dark mode
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Dark Mode Toggle
  The system should apply or remove the "dark-mode" class to the body element when the user toggles the dark mode switch, changing the application"s theme.


Scenario: [Normal] User disables dark mode  
  Given the "Loan Calculator" page is loaded and dark mode is enabled  
  When the user toggles the dark mode slider with data-testid "dark-mode-slider" to the "unchecked" position  
  Then the body element should not have the class "dark-mode"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User rapidly toggles dark mode switch multiple times
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Dark Mode Toggle
  The system should apply or remove the "dark-mode" class to the body element when the user toggles the dark mode switch, changing the application"s theme.


Scenario: [Edge] User rapidly toggles dark mode switch multiple times
    Given the Loan Calculator page is loaded
    When the user toggles the dark mode switch with data-testid "dark-mode-slider" to the "checked" position
    And the user toggles the dark mode switch with data-testid "dark-mode-slider” to the "unchecked" position
    And the user toggles the dark mode switch with data-testid "dark-mode-slider” to the "checked" position
    Then the body element should have the class "dark-mode"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Calculate loan payments with valid inputs
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-006 Calculate Loan Payments
  The system should calculate and display the monthly payment, total payment, and total interest when the user clicks the "Calculate" button based on the input values.


  Scenario: [Normal] Calculate loan payments with valid inputs
    Given the Loan Calculator page is loaded
    And the user enters "10000" into the loan amount field with data-testid "amount-input"
    And the user enters "5" into the interest rate field with data-testid "rate-input"
    And the user enters "15" into the loan term field with data-testid "years-input"
    When the user clicks the "Calculate" button with data-testid "calculate-button"
    Then the monthly payment should be displayed as "Monthly Payment: $79.08" in the result box with data-testid "monthly-payment"
    And the total payment should be displayed as "Total Payment: $14234.40" in the result box with data-testid "total-payment"
    And the total interest should be displayed as "Total Interest: $4234.40" in the result box with data-testid "total-interest"
